Question: After being free from istinja is it necessary to wash the penis with hand or pouring water onto it is enough? Answer ID: 157282 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 425/366/B=3/1439) Only pouring water shall also suffice, but sometimes urine drops remain in private part of a weak person hence he should press by hand so that complete taharah is achieved.
